title: texclaims: check that a LaTeX manuscript still says what its data says
description: A Python library and command-line tool that checks the numbers, table bolding and verdict sentences of a LaTeX manuscript against the CSV/JSON files behind them, compares values at the precision they are printed with, and fails a run when a family of checks executes fewer checks than its recorded floor.
